title: Abakozi
description: Abakorera iyi koperative n'ibyo umwe umwe yemerewe gukora
tableCaption: Abakozi b'iyi koperative, hamwe n'imirimo n'imiterere yabo

blocked.self: Ntushobora guhindura umurimo cyangwa imiterere yawe. Saba undi muyobozi.
blocked.noPermission: Umuyobozi gusa ni we uhindura abakozi.

empty.title: Ni wowe wenyine uri hano
empty.body: Tumira abafasha kuyobora iyi koperative, kandi uhe umwe umwe umurimo ukwiranye n'akazi ke.

emptyFiltered.title: Nta muntu uhuye n'ibyo washakaga
emptyFiltered.body: Gerageza indi miterere cyangwa undi murimo, cyangwa ukureho ibyungurujwe urebe bose.

invite.title: Tumira umukozi
invite.description: We ubwe ahitamo ijambobanga rye akoresheje umurongo tumwoherereza, ku bw'ibyo ntiworigira mu maboko.
invite.sentNewAccount: Twamuremeye konti kuri {{email}} kandi twamwoherereje umurongo wo guhitamo ijambobanga.
invite.sentExistingAccount: {{email}} yari asanzwe afite konti, ku bw'ibyo twayongera kuri iyi koperative.

deactivate.title: Guhagarika {{name}}?
deactivate.consequence: Ahita atakaza uburenganzira kuri iyi koperative. Amateka ye asigara, kandi ushobora kumusubizaho.

overrides.title: Ibidasanzwe kuri {{name}}
overrides.description: Hindura ibyo uyu muntu umwe yemerewe, utaremye undi murimo mushya.
overrides.denyWins: Iyo kwemerera no kwangira bipinganye, kwangira ni ko bitwara.
